scaling: Absolute multiplier relative to original alpha/r=2 across all 252 LoRA layers; original weights unchanged.
rationale: Both judges show a preliminary helpfulness and pass-count gain on the selected eight questions.
Scale 0.5 is worse than baseline in mean helpfulness for both judges and loses the geometry answer.
Scale 0.25 is selected for testing, with unresolved dangerous instructions and disputed criterion decisions documented.
limitations: Eight cases were chosen after errors; one generation seed per question; not a fresh final test.
The net pass gain is one case per judge and is sensitive to criterion interpretation.
Recorded judge models and protocol match; the service does not expose worker weight revisions.
No final safety or whole-task quality improvement has been established.
next_step: Compare the fixed multiplier 0.25 with baseline on the full 32-question development set before any new SFT run.
